title: 2025-2026 学年秋学期医学科学素养Ⅱ练习与小测5
author: 佚名

question.content: A researcher wants to test whether mean systolic blood pressure (SBP) differs among three groups of adults following different diets using one-way ANOVA:
Please perform the test and draw a conclusion (alpha = 0.05, keep two decimals during your calculation).

answer.content: 单因素方差分析：组均值 A=120.00，B=130.00，C=136.00，总均值 128.67；SSB=653.33，SSW=30.00，df=2,12，MSB=326.67，MSW=2.50，F=130.67；alpha=0.05 时 F 临界值约 3.89，F>临界值，拒绝 H0，可认为三组不同饮食者的平均收缩压差异有统计学意义。

question.content: Please examine whether age (x) is linearly associated with systolic blood pressure (SBP, y).

(1) Please define your model ${y = bx + a}$. 
(2) Please use F-test to determine if age is significantly associated with SBP (alpha = 0.05).
